title: Wordmark development wall
slide_intent: Compare repeated wordmarks at a common scale because subtle shape and spacing changes accumulate across a word.
strategic_value: A structured proof wall can help select a Lufthansa wordmark that retains recognition while refining details.
demonstration: Rows of Lufthansa proofs and enlarged test strings cover a studio wall beside a person.
practical_value: Judge whole-word rhythm across several alternatives before choosing individual letter details.

content_islands.spec: Arrange alternatives in aligned rows and columns.
